The '''Museum Republica''' was a structure located in [[Axial Park]] at [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was different from the [[Republic Foundation Museum]] in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] which was a scholarly resource of priceless antiquities as this building was designed with tourists in mind. The structure combined the refined presentation of more traditional such museums with displays that exhibited best described as a carnival by attempting to offer something for everyone. It included items of disputed provenance that ranged from a cybernetic lower jaw that was believed to had belonged to [[Darth Malak]] to a pair of boots worn by the fabled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cay Qel-Droma]] and also had an exhibit of a deactivated [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was said to had been recovered from [[Malachor V]]'s [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Museum Republica}}</ref>

In the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Corellia was [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] whereupon the [[Imperial Guard]] raided the museum and used it as their base of operations.<ref name="TORC" />
